title: REPAIR: migration-proof tests anchor to moving HEAD instead of the fixed v0 baseline
description: test_precedent_migration.py ContentPreservationTests (test_only_the_four_v2_fields_were_added_nothing_removed and test_schema_version_bumped_from_1_to_2_and_nothing_else_about_it, 8 parametrized failures) derive their v1 baseline from git show HEAD:.harness/precedents/PR-00N.json. That was correct before the v1 epic was committed; commit f89a7f0 moved HEAD to contain the migrated v2 records, so the diff now adds zero fields and the assertion fails. Same defect class as TEST-SEED-A and the layer's own validity_conditions doctrine: a test presupposed an environment fact (HEAD holds schema v1 seeds) that legitimate activity invalidated. Fix: pin the baseline to the immutable v0 commit a2aceac (git show a2aceac:.harness/precedents/PR-00N.json) via a named module constant V0_BASELINE_COMMIT with a comment stating why HEAD is the wrong anchor. Do not weaken any assertion. Acceptance: python3 -m unittest discover -s .harness/tests -p 'test_precedent*.py' -v GREEN with nonzero count against the live 14-record registry; py_compile clean; only test_precedent_migration.py touched. Hand off to verifier.

notes.note: Verified a2aceac:.harness/precedents/PR-001.json has schema_version 1 (v0 baseline). Acquiring lock and fixing test_precedent_migration.py to anchor on V0_BASELINE_COMMIT instead of HEAD.
